automation_evidence.quote:
Each agent possesses news logic generation,
news filtering, time series forecasting, discussion,
and reflection capabilities.

metric_evidence.quote:
The experimental results on four datasets are shown
in Table 1. Compared with the best baseline, the
average improvements are 31.03%, 36.31%,2.48%
and 18.14% in terms of MAE, MSE, RMSE and MAPE.

evidence.quote:
Finally, replacing Multi-Stage Reflection (MSR)
with traditional discussion significantly reduces performance, validating the use of fine-tuned LLMs
for enhanced decision-making.

practical_problems.note: news selection is the named mechanism; ablations remove competition components but no arm removes or corrupts the news context itself

summary: Competing LLM agents evolve news-selection logic for news-aided forecasting and lower MAE and MSE versus deep baselines and multi-agent variants on four datasets; ablations remove mechanism components but do not isolate the news context.
